question: Q1
subject: git:f3a5362fda0bcdfc444bd9f9db06e94b84ae1784
purpose: Collect complete registration, observation, portable receipt, policy, derivation, artifact, and cache semantics before implementing the four remaining Q1 rows.

execution: every evidence record cited by the selected claims
capture_contract.identity: Every captured file is identified by repository-relative role, exact SHA-256, and size. Generated timestamps may differ between runs but cannot substitute for semantic equality.
capture_contract.environment: Record Proofbound, operating system, architecture, and every executable or backend dependency identity used by the evidence routes. Missing required tools make the case not executed, never passed.

derivation_trace_contract.acceptance: Rust and Python independently derive byte-equal canonical traces from typed IR inputs. Reported statuses and publication decisions are comparisons only and are never derivation inputs.

artifact_contract.acceptance: Every registered input role resolves to an exact observed logical-name, SHA-256, and size tuple before passed evidence is admitted. Every generated, bound, and sealed artifact remains a distinct typed role. Missing, extra, aliased, or same-digest/different-role artifacts fail closed.
attacks: substitute an input logical role while retaining its bytes
substitute input bytes while retaining its role
alias a bound artifact to a different logical role
substitute a sealed artifact and refresh only its outer digest

cache_contract.acceptance: For every route, unchanged replay may reuse only the exact prior receipt. Changing any execution-relevant content, mode, lock, configuration, executable, plugin, analyzer, builder, or negative module-resolution state must change the cache key or fail before reuse. Presentation-only changes must not invalidate technical evidence unless the route declares them as execution input.
attacks: change a directly registered source byte
change an imported or transitive source byte outside the immediate package
change an execution-relevant file mode without changing bytes
change a package or toolchain lock
change a plugin, analyzer, compiler, or builder identity
cache_contract.success_measure: zero stale reuses across every execution-relevant attack and zero technical reruns for the registered presentation-only control

trace_attacks.mutation: replace a formal derivation rule with a stronger rule
mark one unsatisfied policy component satisfied
move a valid trace to another claim
derive policy admission from reported policy_admitted instead of typed inputs

decision_rule.close_q1_field_006_and_016: Every selected claim has an independently reproduced exact trace and all six trace attacks are rejected by both implementations with the registered code.
decision_rule.close_q1_field_009: The artifact contract passes for every selected route and attack in both implementations.
decision_rule.close_q1_field_014: The cache success measure is met for every selected route in all three language cases.
decision_rule.freeze_assurance_ir_1: Only after all sixteen matrix rows are complete and this completed vertical corpus has no unresolved divergence.
decision_rule.preregister_go_holdout: Only after the IR is frozen; none of these cases may be reused as the holdout.
